title: [Master] - Slice 638097: [Expense Agent] Enable simple interim approval scenario
summary: Expense reports now support a two-stage approval flow with interim and final approvers in agent mode, with automatic prepopulation of the final approver from the user's designated approver.
key_points: Added interim and final approver fields to expense report headers with validation rules
Introduced 'Interim Approved' status for two-step approval workflow (or single-step when no interim approver set)
UI and API support for assigning interim approvers, restricted to agent mode
Guards prevent interim approver conflicts (not submitter, not final approver, required selection)
Activity logging tracks interim approver assignments and interim approvals
quote: Enables a simple two-stage interim approval step for expense reports in agent mode.
